title: ws:// resource ref (AIP-54)
description: Validates a ws:// resource reference string — the resource scheme of AIP-54, absorbed from superseded AIP-27. A ws:// ref points at a resource in the world (a workspace file, a URL, an identity, a transaction, a persona); the collection segment maps to a kind by the normative table in AIP-54 §Reference syntax, never by string manipulation. ws:// refs are tenant-local by mandate: hosts MUST resolve them in the same tenant scope as the citing file and reject cross-tenant bindings. This schema constrains the URI envelope and the collection vocabulary only; per-kind body grammar is owned by each kind's AIP.
x-collection-enum-note: The authoritative collection→kind table is AIP-54 §Reference syntax, parsed directly from specs/aip-54.mdx by scripts/check-refs.mjs — the spec is the fixture. This enum is a convenience mirror for validators; a collection absent from the spec's table MUST be treated as unknown regardless of this list. Add a row to AIP-54's table first, then mirror it here.
x-resolution-rules: Dispatch: take the segment up to the first '/' as the collection, map to a kind via the AIP-54 table; an unknown collection is a parse-time failure (UnknownRefCollection).
Tenant-local: hosts MUST resolve in the citing file's tenant scope and MUST reject cross-tenant bindings (AIP-23 — identity_xref_unresolvable).
Loud failure: an unresolvable ws:// ref is a typed failure, never a silent dangling string.
Round-trip: ws://<collection>/<body> and <kind>:<body> denote the same ref; rewriting MUST NOT introduce an @<workspace> suffix — the tenant-scope envelope MUST stay closed.
Source of truth: the kind's owning AIP owns what exists; the ref is only the wire shape.
